messages:
Anya K.: Quick question from our Lisbon <> Porto trip: rental was on company card but we paid cash for fuel, a few tolls (no printed ticket), and one group ferry. One teammate paid ferry for everyone. Do we file actuals or use per-diem for the days with lots of small cash expenses?
Maya (People Ops): File actuals for fuel/tolls/ferry when possible. Per-diem only for meals and incidentals; it can't be used to replace documented transport or lodging. If a receipt is missing: amounts <= $25 use Lost-Receipt form; $25-$75 need manager approval; >$75 needs original receipt or Finance exception. Link: https://intranet.redwood/expenses (International cash receipts).
Ravi (Finance): For cash items, attach a photo of the receipt if available. If toll machines produced no ticket, attach the bank/card line that shows the cash withdrawal or a photo of the machine and a short note with date/time. For currency conversion we use the FX provider rate on the date of transaction; you can also attach the card statement showing USD.
Anya K.: For the group ferry where Sam paid EUR 240, what's the recommended way to split?
Maya (People Ops): Create one expense for the full ferry charge, mark Original Payer: Sam, and in the description use an explicit split list. Example to paste into the description field:
Expense: Ferry (group)
Original payer: Sam
Split: Sam 40.00, Anya 40.00, Jordan 40.00, Priya 40.00, Mei 40.00, Alex 0.00 (company-covered)
Currency: EUR
Notes: offsite travel 2026-03
Maya (People Ops): Also upload the original ferry receipt. Each person should add a matching reimbursement item for their share (with a reference to the original expense id) or the original payer can submit and request reimbursements to be split; either workflow is fine as long as the description and attendee list match.
Anya K.: Any VAT reclaim nuance for Portugal? We have rental invoice with VAT but rental was under my name (not company).
Ravi (Finance): Finance can only reclaim VAT if the invoice is issued to Redwood Inference (company name and address). Ask the vendor for a corrected invoice; if not possible, file the expense and flag "VAT reclaim" — Finance will review but may not be able to recover VAT.
ExpenseBot: :receipt: Missing receipt checklist: date, merchant, amount, currency. Handwritten or photo slips accepted if legible. Missing receipt thresholds: <= $25 (lost-receipt form), $25-75 (manager approval), >$75 (not allowed without original receipt).
Maya (People Ops): If multiple small cash items on the same day (cafes, metro tokens) and receipts are missing, you can use per-diem for meals only. For transport, follow lost-receipt steps. If you need reimbursement faster because you fronted a lot, DM People Ops for an advance.
Anya K.: Perfect, I'll collect photos and bank lines and submit the split. Thanks! :thumbsup:
